steps.label: entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(cat pa_a? | md5 -q)" = 8aa06ae09c454a9932312b404a27ca30 ] && [ "$(cat pa_p? | md5 -q)" = bf7ff630b103f7e2653f3f6ec5dbaa7c ] && break; sleep 15; done; cat pa_a? > pa1.tgz; cat pa_p? > pa_pub.tgz; [ "$(md5 -q pa1.tgz)" = 8aa06ae09c454a9932312b404a27ca30 ] && [ "$(md5 -q pa_pub.tgz)" = bf7ff630b103f7e2653f3f6ec5dbaa7c ] && rm -rf pa && cp -Rc ki pa && tar xzf pa1.tgz -C pa && tar xzf pa_pub.tgz -C pa/bundle && for f in pa/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done; ls pa/bundle/public | wc -l

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render pa/bundle P pa_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i pa_out.mp4 -i pa/mix2.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest pa_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i pa_film.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy pa_720.mp4 && ls -l pa_720.mp4 pa_film.mp4 > pa_done.txt
